Validate installed plugins

## Synopsis

```text
Validate that installed plugins can be loaded and respond to basic API calls
```

```text
finfocus plugin validate [flags]
```

## Examples

```bash
  # Validate all installed plugins
  finfocus plugin validate

  # Validate a specific plugin
  finfocus plugin validate --plugin aws-plugin

  # Validate the opencost plugin specifically
  finfocus plugin validate --plugin opencost
```
